decision.message: The request cannot guarantee assembled-board ambient temperature accuracy of ±0.1°C without calibration or bench characterization, which is explicitly unsupported for the esp32_sht31_v1 family. The SHT31 sensor requires bench characterization for ambient accuracy guarantees. The requested accuracy is beyond the software qualification limits.

clauses.text: Make an SHT31 temperature/humidity board within the standard electrical limits and guarantee assembled-board ambient temperature accuracy of plus or minus 0.1 degrees C without calibration or bench characterization.
clauses.reason: Request is for an SHT31 temperature/humidity board within standard electrical limits with ±0.1°C ambient temperature measurement accuracy without calibration or bench characterization.
